application.name: Tenant Sales and Commission Control
application.business_goal: Record tenant sales across shared POS and approved online channels, reconcile deposits and calculate contract-based commission.

users.scope: own sales and own statements only

workflows: import or enter sale and append reversal events
compare provider settlement with bank deposit
business_rules: posted sale events are append-only; refund and cancellation are new negative events
source event ID plus channel is unique for replay protection
commission rate and tax treatment come from the tenant contract and are snapshotted on close
commission VAT is represented as a separate amount
never move or hold tenant sales proceeds

analytics.rule: expected provider amount differs from bank credit
analytics.evidence: settlement reference, date, expected and received amounts

analytics.rule: active channel has no imported rows in selected period
analytics.interpretation: review prompt, not proof of missing sales

analytics.rule: absolute tax exceeds absolute paid amount

acceptance_criteria: tenant cannot read another tenant's sales, statement or exports
replaying the same source event does not add another sale
invalid import has no partial financial writes
refund preserves and reverses the original sale
monthly commission example matches an independent calculation
unmatched payout shows both compared values and reference
backup can be restored to a test database
open_questions: confirm each tenant contract's exact commission base, rounding and refund carry-forward rule
obtain official POS, marketplace, live-commerce, PG and bank API documents and sandbox access
confirm hosting owner, retention period and production acceptance operator
